data.title: Income tax assessment 2024 – €1,236 to pay
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterbach issued the 2024 income tax assessment dated 31 December 2025. It shows an additional payment of €1,236.00, due 5 February 2026.
data.explanation: This is your tax assessment (Steuerbescheid) for 2024. Your income tax was set at €15,130.00, but only €13,894.00 was withheld through payroll, so you owe €1,236.00. Pay it to the tax office's account by 5 February 2026, using the tax number as the payment reference. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the tax office; the app shows the deadline. Filing an objection does not by itself suspend payment. A tax adviser can help if unsure.

items.title: Pay additional income tax 2024
items.action: Transfer €1,236.00 to the tax office account using the tax number as reference.

items.title: Objection option (Einspruch)
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch erhoben werden.
items.action: If you disagree with the assessment, file an objection with Finanzamt Musterbach in writing, electronically or on record.
items.consequence: After the deadline the assessment becomes final.

key_facts.label: Date posted (zur Post gegeben)
key_facts.quote: Hinweis zur Bekanntgabe: Dieser Bescheid wurde am 02.01.2026 zur Post gegeben.

remedy.quote: Der Einspruch ist beim Finanzamt Musterbach schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift einzulegen.
